title: Smarter Weather examples index
description: One entry per example and language. An example in several languages is several entries sharing one id; (id, language) is unique, which the validator checks.

id.description: URL slug, shared by every language of the same example.

surface.description: rest: plain HTTP calls. mcp: an MCP client wired to the weather server. sdk: reserved for when an SDK ships.

dir.description: Directory under examples/, starting with the surface.

portal_guide.description: Playground guide slug on developers.smarterweather.com, when one matches.

test.description: Shell command CI runs in dir against the mock (see _harness/).
